lines.en: We cut to the interior of the Kanda family apartment several hours later — where both Kanda daughters are seated in different positions on the couch, meant to emphasize their respective mental states.
lines.zh: 几小时后，镜头切进 Kanda 家的公寓室内——Kanda 家的两姐妹以不同的姿势坐在沙发上，各自强调着各自的心境。

lines.en: The youngest daughter was wide open, the way she always is. Her feet dangled in the air like the hands of a corpse hanging off the twin-size bed of a necrophiliac deep in the act of persistent postmortem coitus.
lines.zh: 小女儿像往常一样四仰八叉。她的脚悬在空中，像一具尸体的手，垂在某个恋尸癖者正埋头进行持续性死后性行为的那张单人床边。

lines.en: Her sister, on the other hand, took up a more reserved posture — hugging her knees with both arms in a way that didn’t just allow her to use them as a pillow, but made her feel more comfortable and protected.
lines.zh: 而她姐姐则摆出一个更内敛的姿势——双臂抱住膝盖，这样不仅能把膝盖当枕头，还让她觉得更舒服、更有安全感。

lines.en: She didn’t think her little sister was going to rape her, though — so she wasn’t really sure just what she {i}was{/i} protecting herself from at the moment.
lines.zh: 不过她并不觉得自己的妹妹会强暴她——所以她其实不太确定，此刻自己在防着什么。

lines.en: Thoughts, perhaps? Did she fear that the man she encountered earlier would return after misinterpreting her final line? No. That was unlikely. She probably won’t see him again for another several weeks.
lines.zh: 念想，也许？她是在害怕傍晚遇到的那个男人会误解她最后那句话、然后折回来吗？不。那不太可能。她大概要好几个星期才会再见到他。

lines.en: Yet she mourned his absence from the halls of her school. The way she used to look over her shoulder before turning every corner to try and spot him somewhere.
lines.zh: 可她为他在学校走廊里的缺席而哀悼。为那种从前每逢转角都要回头瞥一眼、想在哪儿逮到他的习惯而哀悼。

lines.en: He’d seldom spot her back. In fact, she’d seldom spot him at all. But every time she {i}did,{/i} it made her heart skip a beat. And it still skipped some nights, but she hated that it did that.
lines.zh: 他很少会回看她。事实上，她也很少真的看到他。但每一次{i}看到{/i}，她的心都会漏跳一拍。有些夜里它依然会漏跳，而她恨透了这一点。

lines.en: She {i}hated{/i} that it did that, and she hated it because it meant she was right about something. She was right about how some things are too good to be true, and he was always one of them.
lines.zh: 她{i}恨{/i}这一点，恨它是因为那意味着她某件事说对了。她说对了「有些东西好得不真实」，而他一直都是其中之一。

lines.en: He wasn’t kind or caring. He wasn’t attentive. He didn’t like the things she did and had spent way too much time with the {i}other{/i} girl on the couch. There was never really anything good about him at all.
lines.zh: 他不善良，也不体贴。他不上心。他不喜欢她做的事，还跟沙发上{i}那个{/i}女孩待了太久。他身上根本从来就没什么是好的。

lines.en: His flaws were so evident now — and all it took was a brush with death to pry the blindness from her eyes and change everything.
lines.zh: 他的缺点现在再明显不过——而只需要和死亡擦肩而过一次，就足以把她眼上的蒙蔽撬开，改变一切。

lines.en: She wished it would all change back, though. And somewhere it did — but that somewhere was not here, for this wish had already been made.
lines.zh: 可她希望一切都能变回去。而在某个地方，它确实变回去了——但那个地方不是这里，因为这个愿望已经被许下了。

lines.en: And all that was left to do was sit here hugging her knees while waiting for the couch to swallow her whole.
lines.zh: 剩下的，只有抱紧膝盖坐在这里，等着沙发把她整个吞下去。

lines.en: : Is it just me, or is Tom Holland, like...weirdly hot?
lines.zh: : 是我一个人这么觉得，还是 Tom Holland 那个……莫名地很性感？

lines.en: : Hot? I didn’t think he’d be your type at all.
lines.zh: : 性感？我还以为他完全不是你的菜呢。

lines.en: : I don’t really have a type. I see beauty in everyone, I think. Just, in his case, I want him to take me to his room and-
lines.zh: : 我其实没有特定的类型。我觉得我能在每个人身上看到美。只是在他这件事上，我想让他带我去他的房间，然后——
: Kirin，别说了。

lines.en: : Stop what? I was just gonna say “read me a bedtime story and pat my head.”
lines.zh: : 别说什么？我正想说「给我读个睡前故事，再拍拍我的头」呢。
: 哦……对不起。
: 你平时可比这……扎人多了。

lines.en: : Everything okay? You’ve seemed a little off all night.
lines.zh: : 一切都好吗？你整晚看起来都有点不对劲。
: 你……真的在问？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m good Kirin now. I’ve decided to switch personalities.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我现在是好孩子 Kirin 了。我决定换个性格。
: 你还能……说换就换？

lines.en: : It helps not having any idea what your identity is or even what you like. So you’d probably struggle with it.
lines.zh: : 完全不知道自己是什么样的人、甚至不知道自己喜欢什么，反而好办。所以你大概会很难做到。

lines.en: : Mm...darn it. That’s exactly what I want right now too.
lines.zh: : 嗯……该死。我现在想要的就是这个啊。

lines.en: : What do you mean? What could perfect, beautiful, wonderful Karin Kanda possibly want to change about herself?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？完美、漂亮、了不起的 Karin Kanda 还能想改掉自己什么呢？

lines.en: : I wish I was less nice.
lines.zh: : 我希望我没那么善良。
: 呃……{i}为什么？{/i}
: 那让我变得软弱……

lines.en: : I keep feeling bad about stuff I {i}shouldn’t{/i} feel bad about and everything would be so much easier right now if I just...knew how to hold a grudge.
lines.zh: : 我老是为一些{i}不该{/i}难过的事难过，如果我能……学会记仇，现在一切都会容易得多。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}want{/i} to be thinking about second chances. I want to just move on. But I keep second guessing myself and I just feel...like {i}I’m{/i} doing the wrong thing when deep down, I know I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}想{/i}去想什么第二次机会。我只想往前走。可我总是一次次自我怀疑，总觉得……{i}自己{/i}在做错事，尽管我心里清楚我没有。

lines.en: : I’m sorry if none of that made sense. I’m just really confused right now. But thank you for asking, Kirin. It helps.
lines.zh: : 如果这些话都没什么条理，抱歉。我现在真的很混乱。不过谢谢你问我，Kirin。这很有帮助。

lines.en: : You know...this is kind of annoying.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……这有点让人烦躁。

lines.en: : Yeah, I knew you wouldn’t like talking to me. But I’m grateful you tried anyway.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道你不喜欢跟我说话。不过你还是试着问了，我很感激。

lines.en: : Not that. Just you and Noriko are, like...weirdly identical when it comes to this whole “sit back and sulk” stuff. And it’s annoying because I wish you two would just do what you want for a change.
lines.zh: : 不是说这个。只是你和 Noriko 在「闷坐着生闷气」这件事上……出奇地一模一样。让人烦躁的是，我希望你们俩偶尔也能做点自己想做的事。

lines.en: : But what I want is to not feel bad about being mean and every time I’m mean, I just...feel bad. Obviously.
lines.zh: : 可我想要的是「刻薄的时候不会内疚」，而每当我刻薄起来，我又……会内疚。显然。

lines.en: : Then just don’t be mean. Problem solved. That sort of thing doesn’t fit you anyway.
lines.zh: : 那就别刻薄啊。问题解决了。反正那种事也不适合你。

lines.en: : But if I’m not mean, how am I supposed to...keep people away from me?
lines.zh: : 可如果我不刻薄，我要怎么……让别人离我远点？
: 你可———以……去申请一张禁止令？

lines.en: : No...I’d rather keep this private. I don’t even want to get {i}you{/i} involved. I just feel like I’m going to explode if I don’t {i}try{/i} to talk about it, though.
lines.zh: : 不……我宁愿这事就这么私了。我甚至不想把{i}你{/i}卷进来。不过我只是觉得，如果不{i}试着{/i}说出来，我就要炸了。

lines.en: : Well, you can tell me whatever you want. And I’m not going to, like...ridicule you or...get anyone else involved if that’s what you’re worried about.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你想说什么都可以跟我说。我不会，那个……嘲笑你，或者……把别人也扯进来——如果你担心的是这个的话。
: 我担心的不是这个……不过还是谢谢你。

lines.en: : Karin, chances are I probably already {i}know{/i} what this is about right now. So if you just come out and say it-
lines.zh: : Karin，我很可能已经{i}知道{/i}这事是什么了。所以你要是干脆说出来——

lines.en: : I just need to...stop being so weak...and stick to my guns.
lines.zh: : 我只需要……别再这么软弱……然后坚持我的立场。

lines.en: : I always...{i}think{/i} I’m doing a good job.
lines.zh: : 我总是……{i}觉得{/i}自己做得挺好。

lines.en: : But then every time I walk away, there’s this...feeling in my chest that, like...stays with me for the rest of the day. It spills into the next day too sometimes.
lines.zh: : 可每次我转身走开，胸口就会有这种……感觉，那个……跟着我一整天。有时候还会溢到第二天。

lines.en: : And if that’s going to happen every single time, maybe it would make sense to just, like...stop caring about it?
lines.zh: : 如果每次都会这样，那也许干脆……别再在意了，会更有道理？

lines.en: : You know what would help with that?
lines.zh: : 你知道什么能帮上忙吗？

lines.en: : Please don’t say soup. It’ll only make things worse.
lines.zh: : 别说汤。那只会让事情更糟。
: 按摩。
: 那完全不是汤。
: 当然不是。
: 那个连吃都吃不了。

lines.en: : Just let me rub your shoulders. I used to do it all the time at soccer practice. And I’m still new to this whole “caring” thing, so I’m not really sure what else to do for you right now.
lines.zh: : 就让我给你揉揉肩膀吧。以前在足球队训练时我老这么干。而且我对「关心人」这整件事还很生疏，所以我现在真不知道还能为你做点什么。

lines.en: : Will you really do that for me?
lines.zh: : 你真的愿意为我做这个吗？

lines.en: : Of course. I’d say you’ve earned it after being nothing but nice to me from the moment I was born.
lines.zh: : 当然。从我出生那一刻起你就一直对我好，我觉得这完全是你应得的。
: 那……好吧。

lines.en: : But if your hands get tired or you get bored and want to watch TV again-
lines.zh: : 不过要是你的手酸了，或者你觉得无聊想回去看电视——

lines.en: : You know, this would be a really good opportunity for you to just shut up and stop trying to be so nice.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，现在正是个好机会，让你闭嘴、别再这么努力地当好人了。

lines.en: : But you’re my sister. I could never {i}not{/i} be nice to-
lines.zh: : 可你是我妹妹。我永远都不可能{i}不{/i}对你好——
: 啊啊啊……

lines.en: : Yup. Just like that. Can’t be nice if you’re lost in ecstasy.
lines.zh: : 对。就这样。爽到说不出话，就没法当好人了。

lines.en: : What was I...about to say again?...
lines.zh: : 我刚才……要说什么来着？……

lines.en: : Something about how much you love your little sister, I think.
lines.zh: : 好像是关于你有多爱你妹妹之类的话。
: 嗯…………是————啊…………我爱你，Kirin……

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re......a good girl now.......I alwaaaays knew you......had it in youuuu......
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你现在……是个好孩子了………我……一直都知道你……骨子里是这样的……

lines.en: : You’re a good girl too, Karin. {i}Too{/i} good sometimes, as I’m sure you know. Which is why I think it’s cute that your main dilemma now is just “how can I be more mean?”
lines.zh: : 你也是个好孩子，Karin。有时候{i}好过头{/i}了——这点你自己肯定清楚。所以我觉得你现在的头号难题居然是「我怎么能更刻薄一点」，实在可爱。

lines.en: : It’s......something else, actually.......but......it can.....wait for another time......
lines.zh: : 其实……是别的事………不过………它可以……改天再说……

lines.en: : Yeah. But on the off chance you ever {i}do{/i} want to open up a little more about it-
lines.zh: : 好。不过万一哪天你{i}想{/i}多说一点——
: 慢一点……

lines.en: : On the off chance you ever {i}do{/i} want to open up a little more about-
lines.zh: : 万一哪天你{i}想{/i}多说一点——
: 呃……我……要说什么来着？……

lines.en: : Something I.......don’t want to......involve you in.....
lines.zh: : 一件我………不想……把你卷进来的事……
: 对-对。是啊。累了。抱歉。

lines.en: : You can stop if you want.....I don’t want to keep you awake if-
lines.zh: : 你想停就停吧………我不想害你睡不着——

lines.en: : I’m fine, okay? This isn’t about me, this is about you. And I’m going to help you relax no matter {i}how{/i} I...have to do it...
lines.zh: : 我没事，好吗？这跟我没关系，这是你的事。而且我会帮你放松下来，不管我用{i}什么{/i}……方式……
: 你已经………做得很好了……
: 那个感觉………{i}真{/i}好……
: 你……真的……这么觉得？

lines.en: : M...hm....but you can...go a little harder...if...that’s okay...
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯………不过你可以……再用力一点……如果……可以的话……
: 用力一点……好啊……
: 你是说这样——
: 嗯！对！就是那儿！
（内心尖叫，发情，且羞耻）
: 你真的………很擅长这个……
（内心尖叫，发情，羞耻，且幸福）

lines.en: : We should...do things like this...more often...
lines.zh: : 我们应该……多……做这种事……
: 你是说，像……摸……摸对方？
: 多……待在一起……

lines.en: : R-Right! Yes. Those are the words I meant to speak from my mouth.
lines.zh: : 对-对！是。我就是想用嘴说出这两个词。

lines.en: : I feel like I...barely see you anymore...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我……都快见不到你了……

lines.en: : Ever since...the soccer club disbanded...it feels like you’ve been getting further...and further away...
lines.zh: : 自从……足球社解散……感觉你离我……越来越远……

lines.en: : I miss you, Kirin...and I love you...
lines.zh: : 我想你，Kirin……而且我爱你……
: 我真的很高兴你是我的——
: Kirin？
: 一切都好吗？
: 嗯！怎么了？！

lines.en: : Your face is beet red and you’re gritting your teeth.
lines.zh: : 你脸红得像甜菜根，还咬着牙。

lines.en: : Let me feel your forehead. If you’re getting sick, I-
lines.zh: : 让我摸摸你的额头。如果你要生病了，我——

lines.en: : No! Definitely not! I’m fine! No need to do that!
lines.zh: : 不！绝对不用！我没事！没必要！
: 呃……你{i}确定{/i}你——
: 确定！

lines.en: : I just...um...t...totally forgot I still have homework to do, so-
lines.zh: : 我只是……呃……完-完全忘了我还有作业要做，所以——

lines.en: : Go do that, then. That’s way more important than my problems.
lines.zh: : 那快去吧。那比我的问题重要多了。
: 那……绝对{i}没有{/i}。不过……

lines.en: : It’s fine. I wanted to take another bath anyway. It’s easier for me to think in there.
lines.zh: : 没事。我本来也想再泡个澡。在里面我更容易想事情。
: 泡澡啊……

lines.en: : I can wait until you’re done with your homework if you want to take one together. We did it all the time when we were little. Do you re-
lines.zh: : 要是你想一起泡，我可以等你写完作业。我们小时候老是一起泡的。你还记——

lines.en: : Maaaaybe another time! Loooots of homeworks. Lots of...prooooblems. And words. Word...math problems...you know how it is!
lines.zh: : 也———许下次吧！作业超————级多。好多……问———题。还有单词。应用……数学题……你懂的！

lines.en: : Do you want coffee? I can make-
lines.zh: : 要喝咖啡吗？我可以去——

lines.en: : {i}No thanks! I’m fine. Enjoy your bath!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不用了，谢谢！我没事。好好泡澡吧！{/i}
: 那……有点{i}怪{/i}。
: 不过我肯定没什么事！

lines.en: Karin Kanda, who had never fantasized about having a sexual encounter with her little sister, found herself in the bath — continuing to not fantasize about having a sexual encounter with her little sister.
lines.zh: 从未幻想过与妹妹发生性关系的 Karin Kanda，此刻正泡在浴缸里——继续没有幻想与妹妹发生性关系。

lines.en: Unfortunately, though, she was merely one text box away from recollecting a sexual encounter she {i}almost{/i} had with her teacher.
lines.zh: 然而不幸的是，她离回想起那场{i}差点{/i}与老师发生的性行为，只差一个文本框。
: {i}求你……Sensei……别……{/i}

lines.en: He was undeniably different that night. But the first thing on her mind was not to ask “Why?”
lines.zh: 那天晚上他无疑不一样了。但她脑子里浮现的第一个念头，并不是问「为什么？」

lines.en: In fact, that wasn’t even in the top ten thoughts she’d think. It was buried somewhere beneath questions like “Am I going to live?” and “How much will this hurt?”
lines.zh: 事实上，这甚至排不进她会想到的前十个念头。它被埋在「我还活得下去吗？」和「这会有多痛？」之类的问题下面。

lines.en: Even “Why didn’t I listen to my parents?” found its way in there. But “Why?” alone wasn’t something she’d ask until it all boiled over. Then again. And again. And again. Every day up to this one.
lines.zh: 就连「我为什么不听爸妈的话？」也挤了进去。但单独的那个「为什么？」，她要等到一切彻底翻腾起来才会问。然后是又一次。再一次。再一次。直到今天，每一天都是如此。

lines.en: She always landed on a different answer, paying little mind to any excuse he’d try to come up with since she immediately distrusted him with every fiber of her being.
lines.zh: 她每次都会落到一个不同的答案上，对他试图给出的任何借口都不怎么理会，因为她全身的每一根纤维都已经不信任他了。

lines.en: But there was {i}one{/i} moment in the midst of all of that where she, still fearing for her life, couldn’t help but fear for {i}his{/i} too — for she knew {i}something{/i} had gone off in his mind.
lines.zh: 但在这一切之中，有那么{i}一个{/i}瞬间，她一边为自己的性命担忧，一边也忍不住为{i}他{/i}担忧——因为她知道，他脑子里有{i}什么东西{/i}坏掉了。

lines.en: It was just easier to believe that it was him realizing how wrong his actions were than anything else she could have come up with.
lines.zh: 与其想别的，不如相信那是他终于意识到自己的行为有多错——这个解释最容易接受。
也许那{i}真的{/i}只是个意外？

lines.en: Could she go back to liking him if it {i}was?{/i} Or did this single encounter completely destroy any opportunities she {i}would have{/i} had to make such a terrible mistake in the future?
lines.zh: 如果{i}是{/i}意外，她还能回到喜欢他的状态吗？还是说，仅仅这一次遭遇，就彻底毁掉了她将来犯下同样可怕错误的一切可能？
: 求你别伤害我。

lines.en: And just like that, he was back to normal.
lines.zh: 就这样，他又恢复了正常。

lines.en: : Do you ever dream of me?
lines.zh: : 你有没有梦见过我？
她梦见过。
: Sensei……
: 你有……对吧？
她确实有。
: 求你……别这样……

lines.en: : What am I like there? Inside of your head.
lines.zh: : 在那里我是什么样的？在你脑子里。

lines.en: Kind. Gentle. Smart. Caring. Different. Only one of which was still true now.
lines.zh: 善良。温柔。聪明。体贴。不一样。其中只有一个到现在还算数。

lines.en: : Is it better or worse than who I am on the outside?
lines.zh: : 是比外面的我更好，还是更糟？

lines.en: Worse. A million times worse. And even {i}that{/i} could not begin to describe it.
lines.zh: 更糟。糟糕上一百万倍。而{i}这{/i}甚至还不足以开始形容。

lines.en: : And do you wish you could take me in?
lines.zh: : 还有，你希不希望把我接纳进去？
{i}不要以这种方式。{/i}

lines.en: That was the last thought she could remember thinking before everything went dark.
lines.zh: 这是她能记得的、在一切陷入黑暗之前的最后一个念头。

lines.en: It was like her mind shut itself off as a means of self-preservation — creating an unfortunate save state that she’d be forced to look at every time she wanted to load up some {i}other{/i} memory.
lines.zh: 就像她的大脑为了自我保护而自行关机——制造出一个不幸的存档点，此后每次她想调出{i}别的{/i}记忆，都不得不看到它。

lines.en: She kept coming back to this one, though...even when she didn’t want to.
lines.zh: 可她总是一次次回到这一个……即使她并不想。
: 为什么？

lines.en: {i}Now{/i} was a more ideal time to ask such a question. Because as she gazed down at her reddening face reflecting off the water, she knew it wasn’t from the heat alone.
lines.zh: {i}现在{/i}才更适合问出这个问题。因为当她低头看着水中映出的那张越来越红的脸，她知道那不全是因为热。

lines.en: It was a million things. Curiosity. Hate. Lust. Betrayal. Admiration. Fear. Everything else — dumped into a blender and turned into a thick paste that tasted a little like lemon. Or maybe it was salt?
lines.zh: 那是无数种东西。好奇。憎恨。欲望。背叛。仰慕。恐惧。还有其他一切——统统倒进搅拌机，打成了一坨浓稠的糊，尝起来有点像柠檬。或者也许是盐？

lines.en: Either way, it was a flavor she’d only heard of before. One that she was excited to try one day when the time was right.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，那是一种她从前只听说过的味道。一种她很期待有朝一日时机对了能尝一尝的味道。

lines.en: Yet she was plucked from mundanity like a lobster from a pot — just to be dumped back in when the chef noticed she was still wriggling.
lines.zh: 可她像一只被从锅里捞出来的龙虾，刚刚脱离平庸——厨师发现她还在扭动，就又把她扔了回去。
她很感激什么都没发生。

lines.en: At the same time though, at least she’d know what to think if something {i}did.{/i}
lines.zh: 但与此同时，至少万一{i}真{/i}发生了，她也知道该想什么了。

lines.en: Karin Kanda only touched herself once per month.
lines.zh: Karin Kanda 一个月只自慰一次。

lines.en: Almost always in the bath because it made her feel less dirty.
lines.zh: 几乎总是在浴缸里，因为那样让她觉得没那么脏。

lines.en: But tonight — it felt like she was bathing in shit.
lines.zh: 但今晚——她觉得自己像是泡在屎里。

lines.en: She finished what she needed to do, then hung her head over the toilet for ten minutes before putting her clothes back on.
lines.zh: 她把该做的做完了，然后对着马桶趴了十分钟，才把衣服穿回去。
这并不好看。
这一切都不好看。

lines.en: {i}Karin’s affection increases to [karin_love] because she’s naive and forgiving and you did this to her.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Karin 的好感度提升到了 [karin_love]，因为她天真、宽容，而这一切是你对她做的。{/i}
